title: Kummer exponent compatibility of actual bundle integration
statement: Let A be any finite commutative ring, and let M,N be positive integers annihilating A with N dividing M. Let S be Noetherian with M and N invertible, let F be a finite locally free O_S-module of constant rank d [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section], and let q:mu_M,S -> mu_N,S and b:A_S(1;M) ~= A_S(1;N) satisfy the power and scalar/root generator conditions of FiniteGeneralRingKummerComparison in [def-sp-general-ring-canonical-data]. Let e be the ordered shifted tensor comparison finiteGeneralRingLevelPower from that definition, and pi the projection of the vector bundle of F. Use the fixed compact-support functor vectorBundlePurityLower [thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity, def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Then Rpi_!(pi^*e.hom) followed by the actual vectorBundleIntegration at exponent N equals vectorBundleIntegration at exponent M [def-amb-vector-integration]. This is an identity of actual integration arrows in the ordinary etale derived category, before transposition or restriction to zero. It includes rank zero, the zero ring and empty S.

source.place: Proof (3), exponent independence; proof (2), Kummer projective-line normalization and vector-bundle step.

proof.text: Write M=N*k. The Kummer diagram has power k on the units term containing mu_M and identity on the last units term. Exactness and boundary naturality identify the two scalar-extended first Chern classes of O(1) under the specified generator-normalized root-line map b. The unit columns also correspond, so the normalized projective-line decompositions, and hence their inverse second-projection traces, commute with b.

Restrict along the affine-line open and iterate the resulting counit in the prescribed coordinate order. This identifies the affine-space counits under the ordered shifted tensor of b, with the identity at rank zero. On every bundle frame the prescribed integration is the corresponding affine counit after normalized Tate pullback. Generator naturality gives precisely pullback of finiteGeneralRingLevelPower. The trace equations agree on all frames; unique sheaf gluing, read in degree zero, gives equality of the actual global integration arrows.

theorem finiteGeneralRingIntegrationExponent
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (M N : ℕ) (hMpos : 0 < M) (hNpos : 0 < N) (hdiv : N ∣ M)
    (hM : (M : A) = 0) (hN : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S]
    (hS : IsUnit (M : Γ(S, ⊤))) (hS' : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (d : ℕ) (F : S.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (q : S.rootsOfUnitySheaf M ⟶ S.rootsOfUnitySheaf N)
    (b : Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine S M A hM ≅
      Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine S N A hN)
    (hb : FiniteGeneralRingKummerComparison A M N hM hN S q b) :
    (Etale.vectorBundlePurityLower A S d F).map
        ((Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback A (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F)).map
          (finiteGeneralRingLevelPower A M N hM hN S b d).hom) ≫
        Etale.vectorBundleIntegration N hNpos A hN S hS' d F =
      Etale.vectorBundleIntegration M hMpos A hM S hS d F
